promotion_requirements: Resolve the remaining Legendary Chest identity gap and prove the complete catalogue.
Prove native collectible-to-marker/state bindings rather than infer them.
Generate and verify dedicated Legendary Chest native resource IDs and hashes.
Verify map, HUD and in-world resource resolution and GOPool capacity without modifying Raven resources.
Prove native mapcoords and compassgraph routing for the authored Legendary markers.
Prove authoritative collected-state suppression across reloads and realm changes.
Create a schema-valid data/native-markers/legendary-chest.json only after every required value is real and verified.
Keep runtime generation disabled until the fail-closed Legendary static gate explicitly allows it.
